recordedProductIssues: Review screen text boxes and black masks are as recorded and read small

defects.problem: Screen tile is small with a wide empty zone under the checklist and below it; the four yellow-box items are legible but the screen and its masks are not at feed size.
defects.fix: Rebalance so the screen tile uses the width and the checklist sits beside it at larger size.

defects.problem: Cursor is a few pixels and checkbox 'Name' toggles late; the key moment (hiding a missed item) is hard to see at feed size.
defects.fix: Hold on the Name check change and enlarge the checklist.

defects.problem: Subline wraps with an orphaned 'it missed.' leaving an uneven caption block.
defects.fix: Shorten the line to fit on one line.

defects.problem: 'The exact upload' headline floats top right with the blank band below; the final screen jumps layout from the checklist screen.
defects.fix: Keep the same headline slot and size across both states.

oneLineVerdict: Honest and calm, yet small and sparse at feed size, with a late payoff.
